title: INSPECTION OF DP SYSTEM

content.description: Diagram showing DP Diaphragm with throttle valve open at 3000 rpm, with pinch point between DP and VTV

items: (b) Pinch the vacuum hose between DP and VTV.

content.description: Diagram showing DP Set position with throttle valve released at 2000 rpm, with pinch point indicated

items: (d) Check that the DP is set.

content.description: Diagram showing DP Adjusting Bolt location for adjustment

content.text: If not at specified speed, adjust with the DP adjusting bolt.
